question: I like ___ in the park. (run)
hint: Sau 'like' → động từ thêm -ing (V-ing); run → running (nhân đôi phụ âm cuối)

question: She likes ___ songs. (sing)
hint: Sau 'likes' → V-ing → singing

question: He doesn't like ___ vegetables. (eat)
hint: Sau 'doesn't like' → vẫn dùng V-ing → eating

question: Do you like ___ in the sea? (swim)
hint: Sau 'like' → V-ing; swim → swimming (nhân đôi phụ âm cuối)

question: They like ___ pictures. (draw)
hint: Sau 'like' → V-ing → drawing

question: My sister likes ___ her room. (clean)
hint: Sau 'likes' → V-ing → cleaning

question: I don't like ___ early in the morning. (wake up)
hint: Sau 'don't like' → V-ing → waking up

question: He likes ___ with his friends after school. (play)
hint: Sau 'likes' → V-ing → playing

question: We like ___ new words every day. (learn)
hint: Sau 'like' → V-ing → learning

question: She likes ___ on the weekends. (dance)
hint: Sau 'likes' → V-ing; dance → dancing (bỏ -e rồi thêm -ing)

question: I like reading ___ drawing.
hint: Thích cả hai → dùng 'and' để nối (I like A and B)

question: She doesn't like singing ___ dancing.
hint: Không thích cả hai → dùng 'or' (doesn't like A or B)

question: He likes football ___ basketball.
hint: Thích cả hai → 'and'

question: I like swimming ___ I don't like running.
hint: Ý tương phản (thích bơi nhưng không thích chạy) → but

question: She likes singing ___ she doesn't like dancing.
hint: Ý tương phản giữa hai vế câu → but

question: ___ of all, open your book to page 5.
hint: 'First of all' = đầu tiên trong chuỗi hành động → First

question: ___, wash your hands. Then, eat your food.
hint: Bước trước 'Then' → đây là bước đầu tiên → First

question: ___, put on your shoes. Then, open the door. Finally, go outside.
hint: Bước đầu tiên trong chuỗi 3 bước → First

question: First, put on your socks. ___, put on your shoes.
hint: Hành động ngay tiếp theo sau 'First' (chưa phải bước cuối) → Then

question: First, mix the flour and eggs. ___, add the milk.
hint: Bước tiếp theo trong quy trình, chưa phải bước cuối → Then

question: First, say hello to your teacher. ___, sit down at your desk.
hint: Hành động tiếp theo sau bước đầu tiên → Then

question: First, read the question. Then, think carefully. ___, write your answer.
hint: Bước cuối cùng sau 'First' và 'Then' → Finally

question: First, draw a circle. Then, colour it blue. ___, write your name.
hint: Bước kết thúc chuỗi 3 bước → Finally

question: First, open your bag. Then, take out your book. ___, close your bag.
hint: Bước cuối cùng → Finally

question: ___ breakfast, I brush my teeth.
hint: Đánh răng SAU khi ăn sáng → After

question: ___ school, she goes to the library.
hint: Đến thư viện SAU khi tan trường → After

question: ___ going to bed, drink a glass of milk.
hint: Uống sữa TRƯỚC khi đi ngủ → Before

question: Wash your hands ___ eating lunch.
hint: Rửa tay TRƯỚC khi ăn → before

question: We sang songs ___ danced at the party.
hint: Nối 2 hành động làm cùng nhau → and

question: She picked up her bag ___ walked to the door.
hint: Nối 2 hành động liên tiếp → and
